name: Uehara Koharu
source:
Daughter of the innkeeper. Big tits. A schoolgirl.

Because of her house's location in a very rural area, she is enrolled in a school with a dormitory and is usually away. This time, she is back for summer vacation because the inn is short-staffed.

She is very active and does not have very good grades. Although her breasts have grown, she still moves as she did when she was a little girl, so she often loses her balance and stumbles. She is an unintentional klutz.
